description: Add PSD Export with editable layers - a frontend-only feature using the ag-psd npm package. Generates a Photoshop PSD file with the original image as background layer, inpainted/cleaned image as a middle layer (if available), and individual text layers for each translated bubble (editable in Photoshop).
steps: Step 1 - Install ag-psd: Add 'ag-psd' to package.json dependencies. Run npm install.

Step 2 - Create PSD export utility: Create features/export/psdExport.ts that exports a function exportToPsd(image: ProcessedImage): Promise<Blob>. This function: (a) Loads the original image from imageUrl as pixel data (using canvas). (b) If translatedImageUrl exists, loads it as a second layer. (c) For each bubble in image.bubbles, creates a text layer at the bubble's bounding box position with the translatedText content. (d) Uses ag-psd's writePsd() to generate the PSD buffer. (e) Returns a Blob for download.

Step 3 - PSD layer structure: Layer 0 (bottom): 'Original' - the full source image as a pixel layer. Layer 1 (optional): 'Cleaned' - the inpainted/cleaned image if available. Layer 2+: One text layer per bubble named 'Bubble N - [first 20 chars of text]' positioned at the bubble's box coordinates (converted from 0-1000 scale to actual pixel coordinates based on image dimensions).

Step 4 - Add export button to ViewerToolbar: In components/ViewerToolbar.tsx or components/MangaViewer.tsx, add a 'Export PSD' button (using DocumentArrowDownIcon or similar) that calls the psdExport function and triggers a browser download. Only show when the image has status 'done'.

Step 5 - Alternatively, add the PSD export to the existing toolbar area in MangaViewer.tsx. Look for existing download/export buttons and add alongside them. If there is no export section yet, add one to the viewer's top toolbar area.

Step 6 - Handle download: Create a helper that converts the Blob to a downloadable file using URL.createObjectURL + a temporary <a> element with download attribute. Filename: '{originalFileName}.psd'.
acceptance_criteria: ag-psd is listed in package.json dependencies
PSD export button is visible in the viewer toolbar when an image has status 'done'
PSD contains at minimum the original image layer and text layers for each bubble
